integrity: The analytic limit is independently spot-checked by direct finite-dimensional matrix calculations, but no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: PPT/NPT only across one qubit versus the rest; PPT is not a separability conclusion. The negative eigenvalue near threshold is exponentially small; ideal global entangled resets assumed. Equality at the limiting scaled constant is not classified by first-order asymptotics.
title: Exponentially small reset-rate threshold for partial-transpose entanglement of noisy W states
